newsitem.title: USA: MIM Corp says it boosts client base 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: MIM Corp says it boosts client base 20 pct.

text.p: MIM Corp on Monday said it won new contracts that have increased its client base 20 percent.
The company did not say what the contracts would mean to its revenue or earnings.
The contracts, to be serviced through the company's ProMark unit, cover an additional 237,000 people, the company said.
Under one contract, from Association Marketing Enterprises Inc in Marietta, Georgia, the company will offer about 165,000 people pharmacy services.
The company also received contracts from Southeast Medical Alliance, First Health, Catalyst Rx and Georgia Baptist Healthcare Systems, it said.
Company officials were not available to comment.
MIM is a pharmacy benefit management organization.
